# Stop offering “Mark applied” after an opportunity is already applied

## What & Why
The home shortcut remains available for any non-closed opportunity, including one whose status is already Applied. Hiding or replacing that action prevents a misleading repeat action and makes the dashboard state clearer.

## Done looks like
- An Applied opportunity does not show the home page’s “Mark applied” action.
- The dashboard still shows the opportunity in the correct application count.
- A browser regression test covers the post-application home state after reload.

- artifacts/escape-hatch/src/App.tsx
